learning_outcomes.text: Acquiring the derivations of mathematical expressions for equivalent circuit models of DC and AC motors.
Acquiring the conceptual understanding of electric motor driving techniques.
Acquiring the rectifier, converter, and inverter topologies applied in electric motor drive designs.
Analyzing electric motor drive systems and observing their operating principles through simulation-based application.
Interpreting output voltage and current waveforms of power electronics-based drives.

syllabus_topics: Classification of Motor Drives and motor driving principles
DC motor control with controlled rectifier for variable speed systems, Chopper control DC motor drive systems
Principles of four-quadrant drives, examination and testing of DC motor drives
Principles of four-quadrant drives, examination and testing of DC motor drives
Classification of AC Motor Drives, Three-phase full bridge inverters, PWM inverters
Hysteresis current controlled inverters, Multi-level inverters
Brushless DC motor and Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor drives
Examination of brushless DC motor drives by operating them
Efficiency of motor drives, energy recovery and applications
Efficiency of motor drives, energy recovery and applications
